kind: slideshow of saved actual execution observations; not continuous footage or generated predictions

selection.rule: Among T-JEPA-success/LeWM-failure development starts, sort historical min-distance reduction ascending; upper central observed example; row breaks ties
selection.improvement_metric: historical LeWM minimum state distance minus T-JEPA minimum state distance (not final distance)

provenance.distance_definition: L2 over PushT live seven-dimensional state including agent velocity; successful termination requires position/angle thresholds, not this distance
provenance.frames: Actual executed render after every five raw control steps; terminal partial block retained, steps saved; no frames after selected termination
provenance.first_action_block: Two first five-step blocks independently re-executed from the same restored root; successors saved as *_first_succ; exact terminal RGB validates full recorded action replay
